title: Get started
seoTitle: Get started with Plozz on Apple TV, iPhone, and iPad
description: Install Plozz, connect your own media source, choose a profile, and find the guides for watching and personalizing your setup.

title: Connect a server
seoTitle: Connect Jellyfin, Plex, Emby, or Silo to Plozz
description: Connect a media server, restore an expired sign-in, select libraries and server users, and manage trusted local or remote addresses.

title: Network shares
seoTitle: Add SMB, NFS, WebDAV, SFTP, or FTP libraries in Plozz
description: Connect a network folder, choose its content type, scan files, and check authentication, matching, and share-specific limits.

title: Find and organize media
seoTitle: Browse, search, and organize your media in Plozz
description: Browse titles and collections, combine filters, watch trailers, choose a copy, manage history, and recover missing or incomplete library results.

title: Browse more from Home
seoTitle: Browse and filter more titles from Plozz Home rows
description: Open a Home row's larger grid on Apple TV, iPhone, or iPad, filter unwatched titles, change sorting, and recover row-loading errors.

title: Save and browse your Watchlist
seoTitle: Save, filter, and sort your Plozz Watchlist
description: Save movies and shows, filter or sort Watchlist entries, and understand profile identity, missing titles, and changes to connected server and tracker lists.

title: Customize library pages
seoTitle: Customize Plozz library tabs, rows, and collection covers
description: Arrange library tabs and Recommended rows, choose collection-cover shapes, and size Apple TV headers without changing files, permissions, or Home rows.

title: Browse libraries together
seoTitle: Browse All Libraries in Plozz on Apple TV, iPhone, and iPad
description: Show All Libraries and library shortcuts, browse several servers together, choose a copy, and use Apple TV's letter rail with its loading limits.

title: Home and navigation
seoTitle: Customize Plozz Home rows, hero, and navigation
description: Arrange Home rows, filter watched suggestions, choose hero sources and Apple TV navigation layouts, and restore hidden shortcuts without changing access.

title: Player controls
seoTitle: Use Plozz chapters, player controls, versions, and skip markers

references.text: Ask to resume or start over

title: Use another video player
seoTitle: Use Infuse, VLC, or Native Player with Plozz

emphasis: Start a supported movie or episode

title: Streaming quality
seoTitle: Set Plozz streaming quality and buffering
description: Set mobile network quality, change one stream, distinguish conversion from original playback, and understand video buffering.

title: Audio tracks and output
seoTitle: Plozz audio tracks, output compatibility, and dialogue controls
description: Choose audio languages and lossless or compressed output, adjust Apple TV dialogue, use mobile background audio, and preview detail-page music.

title: Subtitles
seoTitle: Choose, style, and synchronize subtitles in Plozz
description: Select or search subtitles, use a second text track, set language and SDH preferences, and resolve timing or image-subtitle limits.

title: Listen to music
seoTitle: Play server music, playlists, and lyrics in Plozz on Apple TV

title: IPTV and Live TV
seoTitle: Set up IPTV, guide listings, and library channels in Plozz
description: Connect IPTV or server TV, restore channel identities, correct guides, check links, save Multiview layouts, and create library channels.

title: Organize channels and fix listings
seoTitle: Organize Plozz Live TV channels and correct guide listings
description: Find hidden channels, manage favorites and regional filters, correct guide matching, and safely restore channels hidden by availability scans.

references.text: Filter IPTV by country or language

title: Watch offline
seoTitle: Download videos for offline viewing in Plozz on iPhone and iPad
description: Save and verify an offline copy, choose download quality and networks, manage storage, and understand background-transfer limits.

title: Appearance and language
seoTitle: Change Plozz themes, cards, artwork, and interface language
description: Customize card labels, watch marks, episode counts and progress bars, resize headers, choose artwork, and keep app language separate from media languages.

title: Spoiler protection
seoTitle: Hide episode spoilers and change Continue Watching cards in Plozz
description: Protect unwatched episode images and text, hide ratings, and choose Continue Watching artwork or whether selecting a Home card plays it.

title: Circadian Mode
seoTitle: Schedule warm and dim playback with Plozz Circadian Mode
description: Choose sunset-based or manual dimming, adjust warmth and fade, preview the schedule, and restore the normal app picture.

title: Metadata and ratings

description: Choose metadata sources, verify a TMDB token, use local NFO files or Jellyfin plugin ratings, and distinguish review scores from family guidance.

title: Apple TV users and automatic sign-in
seoTitle: Automatically sign in to a Plozz profile for each Apple TV user
description: Remember a Plozz profile for each Apple TV user, choose automatic sign-in, and understand shared accounts, PIN checks, and returning to browsing.

title: Profiles, kids, and locks
seoTitle: Set up Plozz profiles, choose server users, and manage profile locks
description: Import Plex Home profiles, choose server users, add sign-ins, configure profile locks and Kids safeguards, and understand automatic sign-in.

title: Parental controls
seoTitle: Plozz parental controls: Kids profiles, PINs, and content limits
description: Set up Kids profiles and a Parental PIN in Plozz, restrict connected media sources, and understand Discovery, playlist approvals, and content-filtering limits.

title: Profiles and sync

description: Compare iCloud settings, nearby setup, Live TV sync, and watch history; interpret sync-data sizes and understand local state and reset effects.

title: Tracking integrations
seoTitle: Connect Trakt, WeTrakr, and other trackers to Plozz

title: Request movies and shows
seoTitle: Request movies and TV seasons through Seerr in Plozz
description: Connect Seerr, map request users, request missing seasons of library shows, interpret regional availability, and resolve permissions or relinking.

title: Device and system controls
seoTitle: Use Plozz device controls, Apple TV Top Shelf, AirPlay, and PiP
description: Use Apple TV Top Shelf and device controls, tune live buffering, interpret Playback Info, and check AirPlay and Picture in Picture limits.

title: Feedback and bug reports
seoTitle: Send Plozz feedback, report bugs, or request features
